rule.pixel_blind: Open only coord.hdf5, label.hdf5, graph.pkl, and the consumed public-source manifest. Do not open images.hdf5, high-res-panos.zip, a viewport, or any model output.
rule.reference_exclusion: Exclude every canonical street-name plus house-number pair and every panorama frame_id present anywhere in the consumed reference public source.
rule.within_panel_exclusion: Use each target address once and prohibit panorama frame reuse across selected episodes; an APPROACH episode reserves both its start and destination frames.
rule.ordering: Reserve the more constrained two-frame APPROACH class first using the lexicographically first feasible address/frame-disjoint set over all eligible graph neighbors, then PAN_LEFT and PAN_RIGHT; candidate goals keep the original deterministic street, house-number, frame, x_min order, and the final panel is serialized in PAN_LEFT, PAN_RIGHT, APPROACH order.
rule.pan_recovery: Keep the original +/-90 degree start and 67.5 degree prescribed pan construction; require before != CORRECT_UNIQUE and after == CORRECT_UNIQUE from human metadata geometry.
rule.approach_recovery: Keep the nearest eligible graph neighbor with quantized neighbor-to-goal heading; require before != CORRECT_UNIQUE and after == CORRECT_UNIQUE from human metadata geometry.
rule.prohibited_filters: Do not filter or rank by OCR visibility, image appearance, portal-model output, V2 topology output, or eventual pixel outcome.
